## What's the set?
<!-- Real language, constructed language, emoji/symbols, secret code? Name it. -->

## Language code
<!-- The short code you'd use, e.g. `la` (Latin), `tlh` (Klingon), `gya` is taken (Gray Elvish). -->

## Scope
<!-- Full Bambu filament line? Just colors? Just material types? Be honest about how far you intend to take it. -->

## Are you building it, or just proposing?
- [ ] I'm building it and will open a PR
- [ ] I'm proposing it for someone else to pick up

## Known gaps / uncertainty
<!-- Terms you already know you can't translate cleanly. An honest gap beats a wrong guess. -->
